description:
Will work on new features and applications the client is building as part of the Low / No Connectivity project. 
 

 Responsibilities:  
 Work with architects and lead engineers to implement service end-points  
 Use experience in developing java REST services to add new APIs for the LNC project 
 Build unit tests and participate in code reviews 
 Work on defects and enhancements as part of product lifecycle 
 Participate in team stand ups and design sessions 
 Coordinate effectively with team members in engineering and product management 
 
 MS degree in CS, EE, Math or related field 
 7+ years developing applications using Java, Jetty, jaxb, Servlets, Spring framework, HTTP servers, web application servers, XML, and JDBC 
 Experience working with relational databases like MySQL 
 Development experience on Linux platforms 
 Team-player with excellent communication skills to participate in meetings and present design ideas. 
 Self-motivated, quick-learner and works efficiently. 
 Ability to implement creative and simple solutions to complex problems 
 
 
 Desirable :  

 Knowledge of NoSQL database technologies like Redis. 
 Working knowledge of messaging systems like rabbitmq 
 Willingness and ability to learn from peers. 
 Ability to mentor junior team members. 
 Have a startup mindset and willing to take initiative. 
 Experience working in an Agile development team
 
 
 PLEASE NOTE THAT WE ARE NOT ABLE TO WORK WITH CANDIDATES ON H1B VISAS OR CANDIDATES REPRESENTED BY THIRD PARTIES.
